strategies.name: Recursive Character
strategies.description: Splits text by a hierarchy of separators (paragraph, sentence, word) until each chunk fits the target size. Good general-purpose default.

strategies.name: Semantic Splitter
strategies.description: Groups sentences by embedding-similarity breakpoints, producing variable-size chunks that respect topical boundaries.

strategies.name: Sliding Window
strategies.description: Fixed-size windows with configurable stride. Useful for code or transcripts where structural separators are weak.

strategies.name: Markdown Aware
strategies.description: Respects Markdown headings, code blocks, and list structure so chunks stay readable.

strategies.name: Code Aware
strategies.description: Splits along code constructs (functions, classes, blocks) per language so symbols stay intact.

strategies.name: Sentence
strategies.description: Sentence-level splitting with a small overlap. Best for FAQ and short-answer corpora.

strategies.name: Paragraph
strategies.description: One chunk per paragraph. Best when source documents have well-structured prose.
